title: Build a rotation from two basis vectors
purpose: Read a positive one-radian rotation as geometry and as a checked coordinate calculation.
contract: Positive angles rotate counterclockwise; coordinate axes are a and b.
For [1,2], squared norm is 5 before and after rotation, up to floating-point error.
